purpose: second, independent path for unit conversion and reference-band checks; used to audit, not to relabel, the synthetic corpus

sources.publisher: IUPAC Commission on Isotopic Abundances and Atomic Weights (CIAAW)
sources.title: Standard Atomic Weights
sources.used_for: abridged atomic weights C 12.011, H 1.008, N 14.007, O 15.999; used to derive molar masses of glucose (C6H12O6) and creatinine (C4H7N3O)
sources.verification: molar mass recomputed from the molecular formula in clinforge/lab_standards.py; no dependence on the project's REFERENCE_INTERVALS table

sources.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)
sources.title: SI prefixes
sources.used_for: g/dL -> g/L (deci = 10^-1, so 1 g/dL = 10 g/L); mg/dL -> mg/L for the glucose derivation

sources.title: Definition of the enzyme unit (U)
sources.citation: 1 U = 1 micromole of substrate converted per minute under defined conditions; enzyme activity is reported in U/L and is not converted by molar mass
sources.used_for: ALT and AST are handled as activity concentrations; no mass conversion is applied
sources.verification: definitional; the project reports the same U/L value it displays

reference_bands.status: demo values for pipeline testing; NOT a clinical reference standard
reference_bands.provenance: independently transcribed into clinforge/lab_standards.py so that a transcription error in clinforge/hpo_knowledge.py can be detected; the values themselves are not traceable to a single laboratory standard
reference_bands.limitation: real reference intervals depend on method, analyser, population and age/sex; no such data are available in this environment

not_claimed: that these bands are clinically correct
that the synthetic lab values are clinically plausible
that the independent path replaces a laboratory information system or an external quality-assessment scheme
